definition.html:
Theme Shift
CHROMA/04
01 / EMBER

Heat leaves
a memory.

A warm opening state built from mineral orange, dark umber, and one bright cream signal.

02 / MOSS

Growth finds
the edge.

Green deepens the field while acidic chartreuse carries the interactive emphasis forward.

03 / COBALT

Distance turns
electric.

Blue compresses the atmosphere; pale cyan keeps the typographic hierarchy legible.

04 / PARCHMENT

Light returns
to matter.

The journey resolves into paper, charcoal ink, and a restrained red editorial mark.
